name: Evangeline Morgan
source: A criminal defense attorney in private practice, Morgan is amiable, lighthearted, and easygoing- Outwardly. Her airhead act doesn’t fool everyone, but she’s got a dozen more acts to follow if needed. Charismatic and charming by most measures, flippant and manipulative by others- She’s hard to dislike and impossible to know well. Intensely curious and naturally inquisitive, she finds herself entangled amidst the corruption, violence, and mystery of a city that’s not even half as clean as it pretends to be.
